page.layout: One page of verse in one block, with short notes in the right margin beside lines 10, 30 and 37, and a catchword at the lower right. Running head centred at top, page number at top left.

main_text.p: Mortifero gregibus corrumpere pabula tabo. Dira per incautum &[?] serpant contagia vulgus, Corripiatque ardens vel singula corpora morbus. Ille quidem felix: nos contra quanta malorum Circumstat series! miserabile fundite carmen Custodes pecudum, & tumulo superaddite carmen; Hic situs est Damon, hinc usque ad sidera notus, Sic decus omne suis, Viti velut sua, gregique Taurus, & ut pingui feges aruo, laureaque horto. Omnia nunc lugent: colles quando hofce reliquitP. AEquiparans Damon calamis & voce magistros Quos Rhodani ad ripas mirata & ad Al[?]dos undas Cantantes, nostra longe felicior atas: Ad quos obstupuit Tigurinus Limagus olim, Ad quorum voces cursus retraxit aquarum Sequana Parrisios fecundans molliter agros. Omnia muta tacent: quis nunc erit alter ab illo? Argutumque canet sub montibus hisce cicuta Terribilique lupis & furibus? hanc simul ore Inflauit: subito sunt facta silentia in agris Omnibus: ipsa etiam rana tacuere palustres. Testis erit Viadrus, cumque albi flauus Elister, Testis erit Sala cum Nicro Rhenoque perenni: Nullus ad hos fluuios pastorum, nullius opinor Damoni voluit contendere: quin etiam si Communes operas vel sex conferre parárent, vel plures, vel tres, vel quatuor, haud tamen ausi Damonis certare, quod iis symphonia discors Ex templo fieret, risumque audita moueret. Carpite, quos mittit varios humus humida flores,P. Lilia, narcissos, ferrugineosque hyacinthos, Intyba cum violis, casiaque, rosisque, thymoque, Et breue Damonis magni conspergite bustum, Cuius in his terris nomen laudesque manebunt, Dum cythiso pascentur apes, dum fronde capella, Dum fluuius piscis gaudebit, rore cicada. Lenta inter quantum sese Siburna cupressusAl. Erigit, ac humilis inter procera myricas Alnus, tantum inter reliquas caput extulit urbes Patria Damonis, quae sit pulcerrima quamuis Rebus opima bonis, multa munita vi[?]rum Si:

page.notes: Symbol before "contagia" and "Carpite" area and the "&" forms are printed as a special ligature; transcribed as & with [?] where doubtful. "Alidos" in line 12 is unclear. "Sirum Si:" at the end of the last line is partly illegible; the reading "vi[?]rum Si:" is uncertain. Notes P., P., Al. are in the right margin. Faint show-through text in the right margin is omitted.
